verdict.rationale: Vonage Video API is an API platform with server-side SDKs, and server-side session configuration such as automatic archiving can run without any UI. That implies programmatic, headless operation, but nothing in the evidence documents CI usage or headless clients for automated testing. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless workflows, headless client or test-harness support, a CLI or automation guide, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The platform includes client libraries for the web, mobile and desktop platform as well as server-side SDKs.
Server-generated Vonage Application JWT tokens grant client SDK access.
When you create a session, you can set the archive mode so that the session is archived automatically.
